tiers.A: primary source page fetched; methodology visible on that page
tiers.B: figure seen only in a search snippet or secondary write-up - VERIFY before customer-facing use

Naver 검색광고 공식 성과 데이터 / 키워드도구 (requires an advertiser account)
critical_interpretation_warnings: ROAS medians differ enormously by channel: Meta ecommerce median 1.86x vs Google Ads ecommerce median 3.68x (both Triple Whale, 2025). A ROAS of 2.1 is ABOVE the Meta median but WELL BELOW the Google median. Never answer 'is 2.1 good' without naming the channel.
CVR is not one metric. LocaliQ Meta 'leads' CVR 7.72% = lead-form completion. Triple Whale Meta CVR 1.60% = ecommerce purchase. Do not put them in the same column.
All Tier A sources are US or US-weighted. Korean CPMs, CPCs and consumer behaviour differ. Label every number with its market in the product UI.
WordStream/LocaliQ figures are medians across campaigns; Triple Whale figures are medians across brands. Different units of aggregation.
Triple Whale TikTok 'Pets & Animals' ROAS 0.08 is inconsistent with its CPA $13.46 / AOV $12.84 - treat as suspect.
A secondary write-up cited Triple Whale Meta median ROAS as 1.93x; the fetched Triple Whale page states 1.86x. Use 1.86x.
